simple.summary: כְּהַל (kᵉhal) means to be able First listed occurrence: Dan 2 26.

definitions.full: H3546. kehal [ כְּהַל ] verb be able ( ᵑ7 id. ; Egyptian Aramaic, S-C Pap.A 6. 8.11 +; Ethiopic compare synonym יְכִל ); — Pe`al Participle active , usually followed by infinitive absolute כָּהֵל Dan 2:26 ; 4:15 (infinitive omitted); plural absolute כָּֽהֲלִין 5:8 , 15 .
